question: Is the initial experimental update contract allowed to stop at `update_partial` plus operator inspection/replanning for uncertain package and Gateway mutations, or must it include a durable doctor/reconcile operation identity before merge?
rationale: The choice determines the product recovery guarantee after irreversible or unreceipted external mutations; tests cannot establish that policy boundary.

options.title: Require recovery proof and reconcile design
options.body: Hold merge until exact-head live proof covers the external mutation paths and the PR supplies a durable operator recovery or reconciliation contract.

options.title: Accept the limited experimental contract
options.body: Allow fail-closed `update_partial` with documented inspection and replanning, provided maintainers explicitly accept the remaining operator burden and exact-head proof is added.

options.title: Pause the mutation stage
options.body: Keep the read-only planning work separate and defer grouped update application until the lifecycle stack has a settled recovery model.

recommendation.title: Require recovery proof and reconcile design
recommendation.body: Hold merge until exact-head live proof covers the external mutation paths and the PR supplies a durable operator recovery or reconciliation contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment most directly frames the unresolved recovery and aggregate-consent decision.
